entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Plauen–Cheb Line is a mainline railway in Saxony, Germany and the Czech Republic, which was originally built and operated by the Kgl. Sächsischen Staatseisenbahnen. It runs from Plauen im Vogtland through Weischlitz, Adorf und Bad Brambach over the national border to Cheb.
